hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in */styles/*.css|styles/*.css) ;; */app/*.js|app/*.js) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$root" || exit 0; base=$(basename "$f"); base_esc=$(printf '%s' "$base" | sed 's/\./\\./g'); missing=""; for html in index.html guide.html privacy.html; do [ -f "$html" ] || continue; ref=$(grep -oE "${base_esc}\?v=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+" "$html" | head -1); [ -z "$ref" ] && continue; git diff -U0 -- "$html" 2>/dev/null | grep '^+' | grep -qF "$ref" || missing="$missing $html"; done; if [ -n "$missing" ]; then jq -n --arg m "Cache-bust reminder: $base changed but its ?v= version wasn't bumped in:$missing (no bundler in this project - browsers cache these files by exact URL, so an unbumped ?v= means the change may silently not load)." '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$m},systemMessage:$m}'; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
